extracted.name: Quick and Easy Guacamole
extracted.description: This quick and easy guacamole recipe combines avocados, green onions, garlic, cilantro, and lime juice. Seasoned salt gives it a bit of different flavor.
instruction_lines: Combine avocados, green onions, cilantro, seasoned salt, black pepper, garlic, and lime juice in a bowl; mash with a spoon or potato masher until mostly smooth with small chunks.
